entries.title: Psalms 112:1
segments: ¶Hallelujah! Blessed is the man that feareth Jehovah, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 112:2
segments: His seed shall be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

entries.title: Psalms 112:3
segments: Wealth and riches [shall be] in his house; and his righteousness abideth for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 112:4
segments: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness; he is gracious, and merciful, and righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 112:5
segments: It is well with the man that is gracious and lendeth; he will sustain his cause in judgment.

entries.title: Psalms 112:6
segments: ¶For he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

entries.title: Psalms 112:7
segments: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings; his heart is fixed confiding in Jehovah;

entries.title: Psalms 112:8
segments: His heart is maintained, he is not afraid, until he see [his desire] upon his oppressors.

entries.title: Psalms 112:9
segments: He scattereth abroad, he giveth to the needy; his righteousness abideth for ever: his horn shall be exalted with honour.

entries.title: Psalms 112:10
segments: The wicked [man] shall see [it] and be vexed; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
